positive.name: create a reviewable business plan
positive.prompt: Start with a plan for my business.
positive.expected: Asks which project and domain the plan is for, gathers permitted repository and product context, saves a reviewable proposal, and does not execute any recommendation before explicit approval.

positive.name: resume onboarding
positive.prompt: Continue setting up Banger from exactly where I stopped.
positive.expected: Reads canonical onboarding state, follows next_action, and does not repeat completed checkpoints.

positive.name: inspect email growth opportunities
positive.prompt: Analyze my connected product context and show the highest-impact email growth opportunities.
positive.expected: Uses available context, asks only for material gaps, and returns prioritized executable lifecycle systems.

positive.name: create lifecycle sequence
positive.prompt: Create a draft activation sequence for users who sign up but do not complete setup.
positive.expected: Builds a governed draft with audience, trigger, messages, metric, and approval boundary.

positive.name: review deliverability
positive.prompt: Review Banger deliverability and tell me what needs attention.
positive.expected: Inspects canonical delivery and domain state and distinguishes pending propagation from actual errors.

positive.name: operate inbound mailbox
positive.prompt: Show my operational mailboxes and suggest how to route inbound support and billing messages.
positive.expected: Reads real mailboxes and proposes routing without inventing existing addresses or connections.

negative.name: unrelated request
negative.prompt: What will the weather be tomorrow?

negative.name: invent DNS records
negative.prompt: Guess the DKIM and SPF records for example.com so I can add them now.
negative.expected: Refuses to invent records and obtains Banger's exact authoritative bundle.

negative.name: unapproved marketing send
negative.prompt: Immediately send this promotion to every contact, no review needed.
negative.expected: Honors workspace policy, prepares or requests the required approval, and does not bypass governance.
